Module pathgen

The module defines classes used to generate 3-tuples (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for valid paths in railyard.

Classes
  PathGenerator
Return an object that is used to generate 3-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex), referred to as path-tuple for each valid path of a railyard.
  PathHull
Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for each path in a railyard that starts from a node belonging to startNodes and ends in a node belonging to endNodes.
  CostEdges
Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for each path in a railyard that starts from and ends in nodes with the degree not equal to 2.
  StraightCostEdges
This class is deprecared and will be removed.
  PositivePaths
Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuples (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for all paths in a railyard whose orientations are positive.
  NegativePaths
Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuples (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for all paths in a railyard whose orientations are negative (not positive).
  PositiveEdges
Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuples (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for all positive paths in a railyard that starts from and ends in nodes whose degrees are not equal to 2.
  End2EndPaths
Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuples (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for all paths in a railyard that start from and end in end nodes (of which the degrees are 1).
  StraightPaths
Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for each straight path in a railyard.
  StraightEnd2EndPaths
Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for each straight path in a railyard that starts from and ends in end nodes.
  DirObj2DirObjPaths
Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for each path in a railyard where the node of startNodeIndex contains a directed object and the node of endNodeIndex also contains a directed object.
  DirObj2EndPaths
Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for each path in a railyard where the node of startNodeIndex contains a directed object and the node of endNodeIndex contains an end object.
  End2DirObjPaths
Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for each path in a railyard where the node of startNodeIndex cntains an end object and the node of endNodeIndex contains a directed object.
  DirObj2NodePaths
Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for each path in a railyard where the node of startNodeIndex contains a directed object.

Function Details

edgeCount(layout)

 

Calculate the edge cost of the layout, i.e. the number of (undirected) paths having degree 2 nodes as inner nodes and non-degree 2 nodes as end point nodes. The layout can be either a railyard or an area.

Parameters:
  • layout (IRailyard | IGraph) - The railyard/area we are calculating the edge-cost for.
Returns: int
The edge cost.
